section_bridge.hint: Stream / envelope bridge options for non-standard endpoints

zh.name: 桥接设置
zh.hint: 针对非标准端点的流式 / 信封解析选项

mode.name: Mode
mode.hint: auto: stream first, fallback to envelope on failure; stream: always use aggregated streaming; envelope: always parse the model_extra envelope

zh.name: 模式
zh.hint: auto：流式优先，失败自动退回信封解析；stream：始终走流式聚合；envelope：始终解析 model_extra 信封

envelope_path.name: Envelope Path
envelope_path.hint: Path (relative to response.model_extra) at which the envelope payload is stored. Empty to disable envelope fallback.

zh.name: 信封路径
zh.hint: 信封载荷在 response.model_extra 中的相对路径。留空则禁用信封兜底。

content_path.name: Content Path
content_path.hint: Dot path of the text content, relative to response or the envelope root

zh.name: 内容路径
zh.hint: 文本内容的点分路径，相对 response 或信封根

reasoning_path.name: Reasoning Path
reasoning_path.hint: Dot path of reasoning content. Field name reasoning is auto-compat with standard reasoning_content.

zh.name: 推理路径
zh.hint: 推理内容的点分路径。字段名为 reasoning 时自动兼容标准 reasoning_content。

tool_calls_path.name: Tool Calls Path
tool_calls_path.hint: Dot path of the tool calls list

zh.name: 工具调用路径
zh.hint: 工具调用列表的点分路径

usage_path.name: Usage Path
usage_path.hint: Dot path of the token usage object

zh.name: 用量路径
zh.hint: token 用量对象的点分路径

language.name: Language
language.hint: Optional ISO-639-1 language code to improve transcription accuracy

zh.name: 语言
zh.hint: 可选的 ISO-639-1 语言代码，用于提高转写准确度

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.hint: Optional guidance for transcription style or vocabulary
